resources.string: Find photos and videos by describing them, for example “a cat sleeping on a sofa”. Search and indexing run on your phone. The model download connects to Hugging Face; your photos and searches are not uploaded.
EmbeddingGemma 2 · 485 MB download. Extra storage is needed for the index. Videos are searched using their first, middle and last frames. Audio is not indexed.
Try this if loading the model fails. Mali and Exynos devices use CPU automatically. Indexing can be slower in CPU mode.
Download queued. Waiting for an allowed network and enough storage.
Download paused. Tap Download / resume model to continue.
Download the model or import it from a ZIP to start.

Already downloaded the model in AI Edge Gallery? Zip its EmbeddingGemma_2 folder, copy the ZIP to Downloads, then select it here. Nested revision folders are supported. The model is verified before installation; Gallery does not import Edge Gallery’s databases or caches. Temporary space for the ZIP and model is needed.
ZIP import queued. Waiting for enough storage.
Finding and verifying the embedding model…
ZIP import cancelled. Select the ZIP again to restart.
Cannot access the selected ZIP. Copy it to Downloads and select it again using the system file picker.
ZIP import failed. Check the file and available storage, then try again.
Finish or cancel the current model download or import, then select the ZIP again.

Scans media Android lets Gallery access, including SD cards. Hidden, excluded and trashed media stay out. For the whole library, grant access to all photos and videos. New and changed files are checked each time Gallery opens. Scans continue in the background while battery and storage allow it.
Checking for new and changed media…
Progress saved. Scanning will continue shortly.
Scanning paused. Saved progress will be kept.
Scan queued. Waiting for battery, storage, or a previous scan to stop.
Ready to scan. Existing files will be skipped unless they changed.
Clear saved AI embeddings? Your photos, videos and model will stay on your phone. Media will need to be scanned again.
AI index cleared. Start a new scan when ready.
No indexed media yet. Open AI search settings to download or import the model, then scan your photos and videos.
Download or import the embedding model in AI search settings first, or switch off AI search in this menu.
%1$d closest matches, best first. AI results may include unrelated media.
AI search is disabled. Enable it to download the model and scan.
Android may defer background work. Force-stopping Gallery pauses work until it is opened again. Completed files are saved after each item.
AI search requires a 64-bit Android installation. Filename search is available on this device.

After an AI error, preview and copy the latest report here. It includes the error code, app and device details, model status and exception trace. Photos, media names and search text are excluded. Nothing is sent automatically.
